text.en:
Repealing Clause. - All other orders, rules, regulations and issuances,
or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed
or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
DONE in the City of Manila, this §" day of March in the year of our Lord, Two
Thousand and Six.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 34671
